description: This file implements the user login feature, including data models, validation, and request handling logic for authenticating users.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: DTO representing user's email and password during login.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: Request message encapsulating user data for login processing.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation logic for the login command ensuring non-null and non-empty email and password.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handles the login request by verifying credentials, generating JWT token, and returning user info.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the login process; queries user, verifies password, generates token, and returns user envelope.
